rationale: Build on the recurrent-tail baseline by shifting the training objective toward the exact scoring regime late in the wallclock budget. The edit keeps the reverse-tail recurrence and quant-aware endgame intact, but swaps training onto a masked-loss path with a gradual prefix downweight and tail emphasis during the final ~120s (or last 192 iters without wallclock). This is compact, compile-stable, and directly targets final_int8_zlib_roundtrip_exact val_bpb instead of replaying another small LR/export tweak.
title: Late Tail-Aligned Loss Curriculum
